newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks rise by lunch after Wall Street gains.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks rise by lunch after Wall Street gains.

text.p: The Thai stock market rose by the lunch break on Wednesday amid bargain hunting and improved sentiment following overnight Wall Street gains and rises in several regional markets, brokers said.
"Gains on Wall Street overnight have helped improve market sentiment here after the market fell sharply," said Bunsom Kesapradist of Asia Credit.
The composite SET index rose 6.64 points to 665.23 on 1.5 billion baht turnover by lunch.
On Tuesday, the index closed at a new 1997 low of 658.59.
Brokers said the market also rebounded as mainly locals moved in to buy especially banks and communications stocks whose prices have dropped after recent steep falls.
The banking sector was first-ranked in terms of value by lunch, rising 1.52 percent, followed by the communication sector, which gained 2.92 percent.
Bangkok Bank of Commerce topped the active list, rising 0.70 baht to 8.10. Advanced Info Services rose five to 185 and Siam Makro advanced one to 59.50.
